summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Fallbrook Union Elementary School District to issue $76,000,000 in general obligation bonds to repair and upgrade school facilities.

tax.text: A Yes vote would authorize $76 million in bonds for school-facility improvements while continuing the existing bond tax rate of about $30 per $100,000 of assessed value.
tax.quote: The proposed 2026 bond has been structured so repayment would begin as Proposition X retires, keeping the tax rate flat, with the financial plan targeting continuation of the existing rate of approximately $30 per $100,000 of assessed property value.

schools.text: A Yes vote would fund repairs, modernization, construction, acquisition and equipment for Fallbrook Union Elementary School District facilities.
schools.quote: The Fallbrook Union Elementary School District (FUESD) Governing Board unanimously approved Resolution No. 01-26/27, ordering a school bond extension election for November 3, 2026, and placing before local voters a proposed $76 million general obligation to repair, modernize, construct, acquire and equip school facilities throughout the District.

tax.text: The No position opposes Measure K’s $76 million school-bond extension, which would continue the existing property-tax rate after Proposition X retires.
tax.quote: The proposed 2026 bond has been structured so repayment would begin as Proposition X retires, keeping the tax rate flat, with the financial plan targeting continuation of the existing rate of approximately $30 per $100,000 of assessed property value.
